description: This file defines the SplashActivity class, which manages the splash screen displayed when the app launches. It handles window customization, displays a splash screen for approximately 3 seconds, and then navigates to the MainActivity. The class includes lifecycle methods for setup and cleanup.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a splash screen with a background color and transition, then navigates to the main activity after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash activity, sets window features, layout, colors, and schedules transition to the main activity.

methods.name: scheduleStart
methods.description: Schedules the transition to the main activity after a delay, ensuring it runs only once.

methods.name: startMain
methods.description: Starts the main activity with a fade transition and finishes the splash activity.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up handler callbacks when the activity is destroyed.
